code_paths.purpose: Called for each ledger entry modified by a transaction. Collects domain IDs and flags malformed hybrid offers or regular offers.
Called after all entries are visited for a transaction. Validates transaction type, result, domain existence, domain consistency, and offer regularity.

flow: if true, check sfDomainID and sfAdditionalBooks

transformations: Used to look up domain existence

description: Implements the ValidPermissionedDEX invariant check for XRPL transactions, ensuring that permissioned DEX offers and domains are handled correctly and that malformed or unauthorized domain interactions are detected and prevented.

test_coverage_notes: This invariant is likely tested in unit/integration tests for invariants, especially those covering OfferCreate and Payment transactions with/without sfDomainID, hybrid offers, and malformed offers. Look for test files such as 'Invariant_test.cpp', 'PermissionedDEXInvariant_test.cpp', or similar in the test/unit_test or test/integration directories. Gaps may exist for edge cases: multiple domains in domains_, malformed hybrid offers (missing fields or extra books), and regular offers affected by domain transactions. Ensure tests cover both success and all failure paths (badHybrids_, missing domain, domain mismatch, regularOffers_).

validation_architecture.framework: Custom business logic (no external validation framework)

validates: Checks if sfDomainID is present on DIR_NODE or OFFER entries and collects domain IDs
Checks if OFFER entry is a regular offer (no sfDomainID)

validations.field: lsfHybrid flag, sfDomainID, sfAdditionalBooks (on OFFER entries)
validates: If lsfHybrid is set, OFFER must have sfDomainID and sfAdditionalBooks present, and sfAdditionalBooks must have at most 1 entry

validations.error_thrown: none (returns true if not relevant type)
validates: Only validates for ttPAYMENT and ttOFFER_CREATE transactions
Only validates if transaction result is tesSUCCESS
If any malformed hybrid offers were found, transaction is invalid
If transaction does not specify a domain, skip further domain checks
Checks that the domain specified in the transaction exists in the ledger
Ensures all affected domains match the domain specified in the transaction
Ensures that domain transactions do not affect regular offers
